73: /**
74:  * Options for programmatically creating an agent through the registry factory
75:  * ({@link AgentRegistry.create}). The caller supplies the single live
76:  * `sessionId` shared by the agent registry and session log (e.g. an
77:  * ACP-generated id), plus optional session metadata (the validated `cwd`, fork
78:  * lineage); the factory creates the session and agent under that identity.
79:  */
80: export interface CreateAgentOptions {
81:   /** The live agent/session identity. */
82:   readonly sessionId: SessionId
83:   /**
84:    * Session creation metadata: validated absolute `cwd`, `parentSession`
85:    * fork lineage, the `seedLength` seed boundary, the coarse `origin`
86:    * classification, and the `delegationDepth` recursion budget. Mirrors the
87:    * `cwd`/`parentSession`/`seedLength`/`origin`/`delegationDepth` fields of
88:    * {@link CreateSessionOptions.meta} in dsh-session (the internal-only
89:    * `createdAt`, used when reconstructing a persisted session, is deliberately
90:    * excluded — a factory caller never sets it). This is durable session data,
91:    * so the session boundary validates and snapshots it before asynchronous
92:    * setup begins.
93:    */
94:   readonly meta?: {
95:     readonly cwd?: string
96:     readonly parentSession?: SessionId
97:     readonly seedLength?: number
98:     readonly origin?: 'subagent'
99:     readonly delegationDepth?: number
100:     readonly agentPreset?: string
101:   }
102:   /**
103:    * Initial replay/fork history. A fork supplies a balanced completed-turn
104:    * prefix of the parent's log. The complete seed must be contiguous from seq
105:    * 0, carry only lossless-JSON data, and contain no open turn/step or dangling
106:    * tool call. The factory passes it to the session's durable
107:    * validator/snapshot boundary before publication.
108:    */
109:   readonly seed?: readonly SessionEvent[]
110:   /** Per-agent options (model, …). */
111:   readonly agentOptions?: AgentOptions
112:   /** Optional creation-only cancellation signal; detached before the returned handle becomes visible. */
113:   readonly signal?: AbortSignal
114:   /**
115:    * Creation-time composition of the agent's scoped world. The factory awaits
116:    * setup after minting `agentCtx` but BEFORE inserting or announcing either
117:    * the session or agent, so observers can never see a partially configured
118:    * world. Setup may return an {@link AgentSetupCommit}; the factory invokes its
119:    * synchronous `commit()` after every setup await settles and immediately
120:    * before registry publication. This lets mutable provisioning revalidate at
121:    * the exact publication boundary. Everything registered through `agentCtx`
122:    * (scoped tools, prompt sections/variables, `restrict()`, listeners, awaited
123:    * child plugins) exists before `session/created`, `agent/created`,
124:    * `agent/session-start`, and the first prompt assembly. A setup
125:    * throw/rejection, commit throw, or owner disposal rolls the scope back
126:    * without publishing either id.
127:    *
128:    * **Setup composes, it never drives**: the callback is trusted same-process
129:    * code and receives the full scoped context, so this is a contract rather
130:    * than a runtime restriction. Drive the agent only after creation resolves.
131:    */
132:   readonly setup?: AgentSetup
133: }

135: /**
136:  * Options for resuming an agent on a persisted session
137:  * ({@link AgentRegistry.resume}).
138:  */
139: export interface ResumeAgentOptions {
140:   /** The persisted session id to load and use as the live agent/session identity. */
141:   readonly resumeSessionId: SessionId
142:   /** Per-agent options (model, …). */
143:   readonly agentOptions?: AgentOptions
144:   /** Optional creation-only cancellation signal for persistence load/setup; detached before return. */
145:   readonly signal?: AbortSignal
146:   /**
147:    * Resume-time composition of the agent's fresh scoped world. Persistence is
148:    * loaded first; the factory then mints `agentCtx` and awaits setup while the
149:    * reconstructed session and agent remain unpublished. The callback has the
150:    * same trusted composition-only contract and optional synchronous
151:    * publication commit as {@link CreateAgentOptions.setup}: all registrations
152:    * exist before either creation announcement, and rejection, commit failure,
153:    * or owner disposal rolls the transaction back without publishing either id.
154:    */
155:   readonly setup?: AgentSetup
